acceptanceCriteria: `tasks-scale idle --minutes N` runs dispatch against a generated store and reports CPU-seconds per minute, read-only.
V1-0913 before/after numbers can be produced with it.
body: Found in V1-0913 (2026-10-11). The idle CPU claims for dispatch (CAL-V0-139, proposed CAL-V0-217) rest on estimates from recorded read costs, because no tool runs dispatch against a store for N minutes and reports CPU per minute.
title: Add a tasks-scale idle subcommand that measures dispatch CPU per minute
